overview_description.description: Swvl offers an app that allows customers to book fixed-rate rides on buses and vans in their network. It allows people to share a ride in a van or bus during morning and evening commutes for a fixed flat fare with no surge pricing. Through an app, one can book a ride at an affordable rate. Launched in 2017, Swvl has its headquarters in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

about_short_description.short_description: Swvl offers an app that allows customers to book fixed rate rides on buses and vans in their network.

product.name: Rider App
product.description: An app that allows riders to plan, book, and pay for trips on fixed routes using buses and vans within Swvl’s network.

product.name: Captain App
product.description: An app for drivers (captains) to manage trips, track schedules, check passengers in and out, and monitor performance metrics.

product.name: Admin Dashboard
product.description: A web-based dashboard providing transit operators and business administrators with real-time and historical analytics on fleet performance, trip statistics, and financial reporting.

product.name: Partner Portal
product.description: A platform for fleet operators to manage vehicles and riders, improve scheduling, and replace manual processes with digital tools.

product.name: Factory Transit Service
product.description: Customized shuttle services for factory workers with optimized routes and schedules to ensure timely arrivals and reduce travel time.

product.name: Office Commute Service
product.description: Employee transportation solutions that provide timely, optimized, and trackable rides to improve punctuality and reduce costs for corporate commutes.
